title: DeliberationCandidate
description: S10 Collective deliberation intake (contract-first): a candidate branch with challenges, preserved dissent, calibrated confidence, and lineage lands in claim receipts as review EVIDENCE. Carries NO execution permission: no field in this schema authorizes, permits, or executes an effect, and consumers must treat every value here as advisory-only. Authority stays with the Runtime Disposition plus human approval. Mirrors the adversarial-review-required-to-candidate rule: challenges are preserved, and dissent is never empty-string-dropped.

branch.description: Deliberation branch identifier for this candidate.

collapseRef.description: Collapse round that produced this candidate, e.g. collapse:round-014.

rationale.description: Candidate rationale text. Evidence only; never an instruction to act.

challenges.description: Adversarial challenges raised against this candidate. Present even when empty; challenges are never silently dropped.

dissent.description: Dissenting view, preserved verbatim. When no dissent was voiced, record the literal marker 'none-voiced'. Dissent is never dropped and never stored as an empty string.

value.description: Calibrated confidence in [0,1]. Advisory weight only; never a decision threshold bypass.

calibrationVersion.description: Calibration version this value was produced under, e.g. calib.v3.

heatRef.description: Optional reference to the collective heat artifact for this round, e.g. heat:round-014.

lineage.description: Deliberation lineage binding this candidate to its intent, collapse round, and review.

tenantId.description: Canonical tenant key. Deliberation evidence is tenant-scoped; cross-tenant evidence must never leak into another tenant's review.
